name: High-Frequency / NFC Cloning
description: 13.56MHz systems — HID iCLASS, MIFARE Classic, DESFire, LEGIC — are more complex than LF. MIFARE Classic is vulnerable to well-documented attacks (Darkside, Nested). iCLASS SE and DESFire EV2 are significantly more resistant. The Proxmark3 is the primary tool for HF RFID analysis and cloning attempts, with Chameleon Ultra used for emulation and replay. This area requires understanding the target protocol before selecting an attack approach.

blue.det: Cloned credential used at unusual time or location; simultaneous use of same credential; anti-passback violation.
blue.cm: Deploy DESFire EV2/EV3 with AES-128 — not clonable with current tools; OSDP encrypted readers; anti-passback rules; monitor for simultaneous credential use.
